claim.claim-text: 1. An optical waveguide system for a head up display, the system comprising

2. An optical waveguide system according to claim 1, wherein the first diffraction grating diffracts a portion of light trapped in the first waveguide by total internal reflection to an angle at which the diffracted light is not trapped by total internal reflection and at which the diffracted light propagates out of the first waveguide to strike the second diffraction grating.

3. An optical waveguide system according to claim 1 or claim 2, further comprising an output region of the first or second waveguide arranged such that light trapped in the first or second waveguide by total internal reflection and which strikes the first or second grating is diffracted into the input angle range to exit the optical waveguide assembly to an exit pupil without striking the other of the first or second grating.

4. An optical waveguide system according to any of claims 1 to 3, wherein the output region is formed in the first waveguide in the direction of propagation of light in the first waveguide from the input region.
5. An optical waveguide system according to any preceding claim, wherein the first and/or second grating diffracts reflectively.
6. An optical waveguide system according to any preceding claim, wherein the first and/or second grating diffracts in transmission.

7. An optical waveguide system according to any of claims 1 to 6, wherein the first and/or second diffraction gratings are coated with a reflective coating to preferentially reflect light that is not trapped by total internal reflection.

8. An optical waveguide system according to any of claims 1 to 7, wherein the first and/or second diffraction grating is made from overlapping layers of profiled material that combine to create a phase profile.
9. An optical waveguide system according to claim 8, wherein the overlapping layers are arranged to be approximately the shape of a blazed grating.
10. An optical waveguide system according to claim 8 or claim 9, wherein the overlapping layers are formed as a rectangular profiled material.
11. An optical waveguide system according to any of the preceding claims, further comprising a projector configured to project light into an input pupil of the optical waveguide system.
12. An optical waveguide system according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the first optical waveguide and the second optical waveguide are separated by an air gap.
13. An optical waveguide system according to any of the preceding claims, further comprising a head-up display.
